findings.reason: a node sent to "read" that record will take `omitted_count`, and its baseline gates will then be two different measures.
findings.text: the changed clause requires each count to be "reported beside the same count read from the closing census's committed record … by the same instrument", but the record reports no such count: its per-operator fields are `form_count` and `omitted_count`, and its operator population is every name whose id contains the operator, not the names that name the operator. Under the section's own rule (a name stating no form, or a variant, does not carry the stored sentence) the record's own fields give a different baseline for three of the five operators: `omitted_count` is 69 of 73, 23 of 28 and 9 of 9, while the section's measure derives 68 of 71, 20 of 25 and 8 of 8 from the same record's per-name `forms` buckets minus its `names_not_naming_it` lists (stored-form buckets are 3, 5, 0, 0 and 13 names). The record carries no field for the measure, and its closest field is exactly the figure that was misread as this baseline twice before.
